text:
Assistant A provides only an introductory sentence with no code, so it doesn't deliver a program at all.

Assistant B provides code, though it has flaws. It takes the top 5 per file and concatenates the lists rather than aggregating counts across all files, so the result is not the true global top-5. It also doesn't recurse into subdirectories ("under a directory"), uses a hardcoded path, doesn't normalize case or punctuation, and its explanation is inaccurate about the result. Still, it's a partial, working-ish attempt that gives the user something to build on.

Since A has no content, B is clearly better.

[[B]]
